features: Whole SQLite snapshot: all permitted source records and conversation turns; no display/search limits

Timed speech/speaker labels and sampled visual frame text
Optional retained media, off by default; current exclusions/redaction and dependent-turn removal

Async native progress/Cancel/completion; backup and library-switch controls observe busy state
SIGINT graceful cancellation and killed-job lease recovery; no embeddings/model load needed to export

independent_parser.scope: Owned synthetic malicious-looking payload; standalone parser behavior only. No browser content executed or network requests made. Not Obsidian interactive acceptance.

native.earlier_completion_ui_bug_on_dffc180: Export wrote4sources8media but Settings did not observe nested transfer completion; fixed by observed child view78962ae. Before-fix AX retained.
native.keyboard: In-app Cmd-K focused search. Global shortcut from owned fixture did not yield a stable enough focus observation to close its acceptance gate; no global-success claim.
native.scope: Actual Cua UI on owned synthetic libraries only, using copies of signed product app. Existing permissions; no normal capture/library, TCC, unlock, external network or account changes. Actual Obsidian interaction not tested.

Corrected per-record/turn pools plus removal of unused CLI embedding model reduced measured peak to 107.33 MiB. These changes were not isolated individually.
